first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: dark red brick wall
entities.identification: The wall surface on the left side of the entrance and around the doorway, composed of dark reddish-brown bricks and light gray mortar joints.

entities.name: grayish-white grid-patterned wall
entities.identification: The grayish-white wall on the image-right side of the entrance, with regular grid-patterned seams, gray-green stains, and a darker bottom edge.

entities.name: off-white ventilation door
entities.identification: The open, tall, narrow off-white door panel at the entrance, with a round silver handle and a rectangular ventilation grille on the lower portion.

entities.name: passage dark gray flooring
entities.identification: The dark gray floor in the passage outside the door, with seams between rectangular slabs.

entities.name: stack of brown cardboard boxes
entities.identification: The collection of brown cardboard boxes in the center and rear of the storage room, with black text, barcodes, and red icons on the box surfaces.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The narrow cart on the right side of the storage room, with two tiers of cyan-green trays and a silver tubular frame.

entities.name: black horizontal-bar grille
entities.identification: The structure on the left side of the storage room, composed of black horizontal slats, vertical supports, and bright gaps between the slats.

entities.name: storage room dark-colored floor
entities.identification: The relatively flat, dark gray, nearly black floor in the storage room, with conspicuous bands of light and shadow on the left side.

entities.name: storage room grayish-white wall
entities.identification: The grayish-white vertical walls on the right side and at the rear of the storage room, with gray blotches on the surfaces and a darker lower section of the rear wall.

entities.name: storage room dark gray flat ceiling
entities.identification: The continuous, flat, dark gray ceiling surface above the storage room, forming an angled boundary with the walls.

In frame 0, the dark red brick wall forms a continuous vertical wall surface and is composed of dark reddish-brown rectangular bricks and thick light gray mortar joints; the brick courses are arranged in a staggered pattern, and the brick surfaces are mottled with light and dark areas.
In frame 0, the passage dark gray flooring is dark gray and is composed of multiple rectangular paving slabs.

In frame 0, the off-white ventilation door is a tall, narrow, off-white flat-panel door with straight, squared panel edges; near the right side is a small, round, silver metal handle, and a rectangular ventilation grille composed of multiple narrow horizontal slots is inset into the lower portion, with faint, thin horizontal lines visible on the panel surface.
In frame 0, the grayish-white grid-patterned wall is a grayish-white wall surface of regular square blocks, with old gray-green stains on the surface.

In frame 0, the grayish-white grid-patterned wall is grayish-white and is divided into regular square blocks by thin dark seams; the wall surface has gray-green stains, its bottom edge is darker, and the right side of the surface has a conspicuous light-to-dark gradient.
In frame 105, the storage room dark-colored floor is dark gray, nearly black, and relatively flat, with conspicuous bands of light and shadow on the left side.

In frame 105, the black horizontal-bar grille is composed of multiple black horizontal slats, with bright light entering through the gaps between the slats.

In frame 105, the black horizontal-bar grille is composed of multiple fairly regularly arranged black horizontal slats and vertical supports, with long, narrow bright gaps formed between the slats; a row of green bottle-like outlines is visible between the middle slats, and there are bands of light and shadow near the floor.
In frame 105, the stack of brown cardboard boxes is formed from multiple brown rectangular cardboard boxes, with red and black printing on the box surfaces.

In frame 105, the stack of brown cardboard boxes is formed from multiple brown rectangular cardboard boxes, with the box edges and seams between adjacent boxes visible; the box surfaces have red and black printing, with discernible black text, barcodes, oval markings, and red handling icons, and the stacks at the front and rear vary in height.
In frame 105, Vehicle A is a small, narrow cart with two tiers of cyan-green trays and a silver tubular metal frame.

In frame 105, Vehicle A is a small, narrow cart with upper and lower tiers of shallow cyan-green trays and a silver tubular metal frame; the tray edges are rounded and blunt, and thin silver tubes form vertical supports and an upper curved tube, with localized highlights visible on the tube surfaces and at the bottom ends.

In frame 105, the storage room grayish-white wall consists of the grayish-white vertical walls on the right side and at the rear of the storage area, with the lower section of the rear wall appearing darker gray.

In frame 105, the storage room dark gray flat ceiling is a continuous, flat, dark gray ceiling surface with soft variations in brightness, and its outer edge forms a clear angled line with the vertical walls.
